system_overview: The Claims Correspondence Copilot drafts outbound claim letters for Harbor Mutual adjusters inside their existing workspace. For each request it builds a claim-scoped context from ClaimCore and DocVault, drafts with Claude Sonnet 5.5 using the full policy wording as a cached prompt prefix, checks the draft with guardrails and a field validator, records an audit trail, and saves the draft to ClaimCore as pending correspondence. A licensed adjuster edits and approves every letter; sending stays in the existing PostMaster workflow, which the copilot never calls.

container_responsibilities.responsibility: Adds a 'Draft letter' action to the adjuster workspace, streams the draft into an editor, shows guardrail and validator findings, and records the adjuster's edits and approval.

Single entry point for drafting: validates the SSO token, orchestrates context building, drafting, guardrail checks and the field validator, writes the audit record and saves the draft to ClaimCore as pending correspondence.

Assembles a claim-scoped context (claim header, parties, amounts, latest notes from ClaimCore; policy wording by product and version from DocVault), laid out so the policy prefix stays byte-stable for prompt caching.
Calls Claude Sonnet 5.5 with the pinned prompt version and read-only tools, streams the draft back, and handles refusals, max_tokens stops and API errors.
Runs deterministic rules and a Claude Haiku 5.5 classifier over every draft to block coverage determinations, liability admissions and other prohibited content before an adjuster sees it.
Samples drafts daily and grades them against the rubric with a Claude Haiku 5.5 judge via the Message Batches API; calibrates the judge monthly against human grades and feeds the quality SLO.
Drafts backlog letters overnight through the Message Batches API at lower unit cost, reusing the context builder and guardrails; drafts land in ClaimCore as pending correspondence for approval.

key_decisions.title: Ground drafts with long-context prompting and prompt caching
key_decisions.rationale: Simplest operations and lowest cost among the options that meet the latency constraint; citation risk is mitigated by the field validator and clause checks.

key_decisions.title: No send capability in the copilot
key_decisions.rationale: Regulatory constraint from discovery: a licensed adjuster approves every letter, so the copilot writes only pending drafts and never calls PostMaster.

key_decisions.title: Small models for guardrails and judging
key_decisions.rationale: Classification and rubric grading are high-volume, well-specified tasks; Claude Haiku 5.5 keeps them cheap enough to run on every draft or sample.

key_decisions.title: Template fallback mode
key_decisions.rationale: When ClaimCore or the Claude API is degraded, adjusters get the approved template instead of an error, protecting user-facing availability.

operational_notes: Prompt and model versions are pinned in configuration; every change ships through shadow and canary stages with eval, latency and cost gates.
Log the Claude request id with every draft so incidents can be traced end to end.
Watch the cache-read ratio: a drop usually means the policy prefix stopped being byte-stable.
